summary: Example arena shooter game kit: input bindings (keyboard/mouse + gamepad), player controller, hitscan weapon, health/respawn, score HUD, input device detection and animation driver scripts.
requirements: Enable the DebugDraw, StartingPointInput, PhysX5 and ScriptEvents gems in your project (HUD/impact markers use DebugDraw; input uses StartingPointInput; movement uses the PhysX character controller).
